perf_labels.notes: Vague performance claim in body; no review feedback or evidence; merged after empty approval.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 43092 total changed lines the diff is enormous, but nearly all lines come from two merge commits that brought in vast unrelated changes from master (e.g., 24731 lines in package-lock.json, 5766 lines in metadata/modules.json). The performance-related change itself amounts to only 6 lines in invibesBidAdapter.js. Consequently, the merge outcome fits a trivial scope; the inflated diff from merges obscures that the real edit is tiny.

review_details.concern_detail: The only formal review (ChrisHuie, APPROVED) has an empty body; no inline comments, concerns, or performance evidence requests were recorded.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A tiny keyword parsing tweak inside a bid adapter; the agent produced a correct, trivial diff and the change was merged without scrutiny, showing that extremely low‑risk string optimizations face no technical barrier.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body only states 'Small performance gain'; no benchmark, profiler citation, before/after numbers, or repro steps.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression or review issues surfaced; the change was approved as‑is.

core_change_summary.description: In modules/invibesBidAdapter.js, the keyword parsing logic was modified with a diff of 1 addition and 5 deletions, presumably refactoring string handling for a minor performance improvement.
